policy: Source integrations are shared pointers and wrappers. Do not vendor upstream source trees or duplicate full skill bodies into AI client roots.

sources.label: Lightpanda
sources.purpose: AI-controlled browser runtime for scraping, JavaScript-rendered page loading, markdown extraction, semantic DOM extraction, form workflows, and CDP automation when graphical rendering is not required.
sources.notes: Docker-backed on Windows. Use native web search for search-engine queries; use Lightpanda for page retrieval, extraction, and CDP workflows.

sources.label: Context Mode
sources.purpose: Context-window protection, long-output routing, and indexed session continuity.
sources.notes: Context Mode is scratch/context infrastructure. Do not store durable facts here when MemPalace is available.

sources.label: MemPalace
sources.purpose: Authoritative shared memory and prior-decision lookup across local AI clients.
sources.notes: Never store secrets, raw logs, temporary scratch notes, or unverified guesses in durable memory.

sources.label: Skill Seekers
sources.purpose: Shared skill creation, enhancement, packaging, and installation workflows from docs, repositories, PDFs, videos, notebooks, and codebases.
sources.notes: Keep generated skills project-specific unless the user asks for universal promotion. Do not copy generated full skill bodies into every AI root.

sources.label: NotebookLM CLI and MCP
sources.purpose: Programmatic access to Google NotebookLM notebooks through the nlm CLI, with an optional stdio MCP server for clients that require a live endpoint.
sources.notes: Requires user-owned Google NotebookLM authentication through nlm login. Do not commit cookies, browser profiles, generated artifacts, or account state.

sources.label: x-cli
sources.purpose: Shared command-line client for X API workflows: account authorization, timelines, posts, replies, search, streaming, direct messages, follows, mutes, blocks, lists, trends, and places.
sources.validation: x version; x --help; skill-router xcli status
sources.notes: Requires user-owned X API/OAuth authorization stored in ~/.xrc. Do not commit ~/.xrc, ~/.trc, tokens, secrets, direct messages, or private account output. Set X_STREAM_MAX_EVENTS for bounded stream automation.

sources.label: Instagram CLI
sources.purpose: Shared terminal client for Instagram workflows: auth checks, inbox/thread listing and search, direct messages, replies, unsend, message media downloads, feed/stories/notifications/profile TUI screens, and agent one-turn JSON commands.
sources.notes: Unofficial Instagram client. Requires user-owned login via instagram-cli auth login. Do not automate login, and do not commit session files, logs, usernames/passwords, 2FA codes, cookies, private direct messages, or downloaded private media. Prefer --output json for agent workflows.

sources.label: Crawl4AI
sources.purpose: Shared local Crawl4AI stack for LLM-ready web crawling, scraping, Markdown extraction, JSON extraction, bounded deep crawling, browser profiles, CDP control, screenshots/PDF/MHTML export, and Python AsyncWebCrawler workflows.
sources.notes: Requires Playwright/Patchright browser setup via crawl4ai-setup. Keep ~/.crawl4ai local and do not commit crawl cache, browser profiles, cookies, screenshots, extracted private content, venv files, or provider API keys. Prefer host-native web search for search discovery and Crawl4AI for known URL crawling/extraction.

sources.label: Firecrawl
sources.purpose: Shared Firecrawl CLI/API integration for hosted web search with content, scraping, page interaction, crawling, URL mapping, file parsing, agent jobs, SDK/API examples, and optional firecrawl-mcp endpoints.
sources.notes: Requires user-owned Firecrawl authentication before hosted API calls. Keep FIRECRAWL_API_KEY, account state, project .firecrawl caches, logs, generated private scrape/crawl output, screenshots, cookies, and browser/session data local. Do not run firecrawl-cli init --all in this stack; install compact router adapters instead.

sources.label: Web search
sources.purpose: Fresh web research through the host AI's native web/search tools when available.
fallbacks: lightpanda-fetch for page retrieval and extraction
tavily-web skill when the user supplies a Tavily key
browser plugin or host browser automation when graphical rendering is required
sources.notes: This repo does not proxy or scrape search engines by default. Keep web search credentials out of repo config.

sources.label: GBrain
sources.purpose: Brain-first retrieval, structured local lookup, explicit memory mirror, and durable agent context.
sources.notes: GBrain mirrors explicit saved memories and offers structured lookup. MemPalace remains the authoritative durable memory store.

sources.label: GSkills / GStack
sources.purpose: Read-only engineering process skills and GStack/GBrain skill sources indexed by skill-router.
sources.notes: Load namespaced skills such as gstack-review, gstack-qa, gstack-cso, and gstack-browse on demand. Do not copy the full GStack or GBrain skill trees into AI roots.
